headline: Minister Bolat's Rome Visit Will Focus on the Impact of the "Made in EU" Approach on Türkiye
summary: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat will meet Italian Deputy Prime Minister Antonio Tajani in Rome. Talks will cover the Made in EU approach and updating the Türkiye-EU Customs Union.
why: The EU-Türkiye Customs Union governs much of the bilateral trade in goods, so changes to it affect exporters and supply chains on both sides.
